chunks: We shall brand him on the muzzle.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean when God brands someone on the muzzle in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as a specific sign of humiliation for the disbelievers of Mecca, particularly Abu Jahl, whose name 'Al-Akwa' (the blind) is linked to this branding. The 'muzzle' (khurṭūm) signifies the sealing of their speech and hearing against truth, serving as a permanent mark of their rejection of divine guidance. This imagery underscores the physical manifestation of spiritual disgrace in the Hereafter.
